Recenter over the truck's shifted body from the wrist view, first gaining clearance and then lowering with open fingers.
Back off the contact-induced tracking error and shift toward the truck across the wrist image before descending again.

Align across the truck body from its current side-resting pose, lower around it, and close the right fingers.
Test the revised truck grasp with a slow vertical lift only, keeping the right fingers closed and watching for slipping.

Relieve the low contact posture with a slow vertical lift while keeping the right gripper closed; inspect whether the overturned truck is retained.
The overturned truck is visibly retained. Carry it slowly toward a central staging area, keeping the right wrist in its own workspace.
